text:
The structure works, so this needs **refine**, not an edit.

- **Cutoff (fc):** simulated fc is 1.059 MHz, 1.127× the 940 kHz target. Setting fscale to about 0.887 should bring it back in band. That is just below the current fscale lower limit of 0.9, so I'm widening that range.
- **Attenuation:** it misses by only 2.3 dB. The likely limit is signal leaking past each Sallen-Key stage at high frequency. A larger Itail makes the amplifier stronger, which should reduce that leak. Larger Cu or Crc should also help.
- **Power:** at 175 µW there is room to raise Itail.

```json
{"action": "refine",
 "reason": "fc is 12.7% high; scale fscale to ~0.887. Attenuation is short by 2.3 dB, likely high-frequency leakage past each Sallen-Key stage; raising Itail (power headroom exists) plus larger Cu/Crc and Q retuning should recover it.",
 "params": {"fscale": 0.887, "Itail": 70e-6, "Cu": 1.5e-12, "Crc": 6e-12, "Qhi": 1.93, "Qlo": 0.707},
 "bounds": {"fscale": [0.78, 1.0], "Itail": [40e-6, 78e-6], "Cu": [0.6e-12, 4e-12], "Crc": [2e-12, 25e-12], "Qhi": [1.5, 2.6], "Qlo": [0.55, 1.0]}}
```
